query:
select
to_char(((ed.start_datetime at time zone 'Australia/Sydney') at time zone coalesce(nullif(:timezone, ''), 'Australia/Sydney')), 'YYYY-MM-DD') as "Encounter start date",
to_char(((ed.start_datetime at time zone 'Australia/Sydney') at time zone coalesce(nullif(:timezone, ''), 'Australia/Sydney')), 'HH24:MI') as "Encounter start time",
ed.display_id as "Patient ID",
ed.patient_name as "Patient name",
ed.age as "Age",
concat_ws(', ', ed.location_group, ed.location) as "Location",
ed.diets as "Diet",
ed.allergies as "Allergies"
from "reporting"."ds__encounter_diets" ed
where
case
when 
:locationGroupId is null then true
else ed.location_group_id = 
:locationGroupId
end
and
((ed.start_datetime at time zone 'Australia/Sydney') at time zone coalesce(nullif(:timezone, ''), 'Australia/Sydney'))
>= 
:fromDate
and
((ed.start_datetime at time zone 'Australia/Sydney') at time zone coalesce(nullif(:timezone, ''), 'Australia/Sydney'))
<= 
:toDate
order by ed.location_group, ed.location, ed.patient_name
name: Encounter diets line list
notes:
This report generates a list of all active encounters with their associated dietary requirements. The report includes:
- Patient details and current location
- Dietary requirements and restrictions.

queryOptions.dateRangeLabel: Enter encounter start dates (or leave it blank for all)
